CAIRN.PanickedTip:
A character that is surrounded by enemies, enveloped by darkness, or facing their greatest fears may experience panic. In these situations a failed WIL save induces panic.

A panicked character has 0 HP, does not act in the first round of combat, and all of their attacks are impaired.

A panicked character must make a WIL save to overcome their condition as an action on their turn.

CAIRN.RandomBackgroundHint: A background is picked at random — never the one you have now.
CAIRN.RechargeHint: What it takes to recharge this relic. Leave it empty for a relic that cannot be recharged — its counter then reads uses rather than charges.
CAIRN.RelicTip: A relic is a magical object, and can be any kind of thing — a stone, a blade, a helm, a pair of shoes. Marking one adds a Recharge tab; filling that in relabels this item's counter from uses to charges.
CAIRN.ReorderHint: Drag an item to reorder your inventory.
CAIRN.RerollQuestionUnavailable: This character has no background to re-roll the question from.
CAIRN.RestTip: Resting for a few moments and having a drink of water restores lost HP but may leave the party exposed. Bandages can stabilize a character that has taken critical damage.
CAIRN.RestoreTip: Attribute loss (see Critical Damage) can usually be restored with a week's rest, facilitated by a healer or other appropriate source of expertise.
CAIRN.RollFaction: Random faction (a world table named "Warden: NPC - Faction" takes precedence)
CAIRN.RollFailedCareerItem: Roll a random item from the failed career's gear
CAIRN.ScarsHint: If damage reduced your HP to exactly 0, check the Scars box and choose the value equal to the damage you received.
CAIRN.ScrollTip: A spellscroll is this spell written once on paper: petty, a single use, and gone when it is read. Marking one sets all of that and shows it as a scroll in the inventory.

BarebonesFailedCareer.hint: Give Barebones characters a second background name as flavour — the career that didn't work out. Grants no items and no mechanics.
BarebonesFailedCareer.label: Give Barebones Characters a failed career (like Knave 2e)

AllowPlayerGenerate.hint: Offer players the Generate PC button in the Actors sidebar. Turn off to hide it from every player mid-session — the shipped 'Toggle Player Generate PC' macro flips this. The Warden's own button never hides.
AllowPlayerGenerate.label: Let players generate characters

AllowPlayerMarketplace.hint: Offer players the Marketplace button on sheets they own. Turn off to close the shop to every player mid-session — the shipped 'Toggle Player Marketplace' macro flips this. The Warden always shops.
AllowPlayerMarketplace.label: Let players buy and take from the marketplace

AllowPlayerRandomization.hint: Offer players the Randomization toggle on sheets they own, with the Roll button and every re-roll die behind it. Turn off to hide the whole randomization surface from every player mid-session — the shipped 'Toggle Player Randomization' macro flips this. The Warden keeps everything.
AllowPlayerRandomization.label: Let players use Randomization on their sheets

AutoRecordScars.hint: When a player character takes a hit that lands exactly on 0 HP and a scar is drawn, also check that scar on their sheet's scar list. NPCs and monsters get only the chat card either way, and the scar's instructions stay the player's to act out.
AutoRecordScars.label: Record rolled scars on player character sheets

ChangeLog.hint: Whisper a chat card to the actor's owners, observers and the Warden whenever someone hand-changes stats, gold, traits, Panicked/Deprived, scars, features or inventory. Rolled generation, damage and other automatic changes are never logged. The shipped 'Toggle Change Log' macro flips this.
ChangeLog.label: Log manual changes to chat

CharacterInventoryLimit.hint: Equipment limit is defined per character instead of global value.
CharacterInventoryLimit.label: Set the equipment limit per-character instead of globally

ContentSource2e.hint: Offer the 20 Cairn 2e backgrounds when generating a character. With more than one source enabled, Generate asks which to use.
ContentSource2e.label: Offer canon Cairn 2e backgrounds

ContentSourceBarebones.hint: Offer the 100 Cairn Barebones backgrounds when generating a character. Barebones characters follow the same rules as 2e ones — only creation differs.
ContentSourceBarebones.label: Offer Cairn Barebones character sheets

ContentSourceCustom.hint: Include custom 2e backgrounds — backgrounds not published in the Cairn 2e Player's Guide: the shipped Backgrounds (Custom) compendium plus any GM-authored ones from your world's compendiums. They appear in their own picker section; turn off 'Offer canon Cairn 2e backgrounds' to generate only from custom ones.
ContentSourceCustom.label: Offer custom Cairn 2e backgrounds

CustomPortraitFolder.hint: A folder of your own character portraits (relative to the Foundry data root). When it holds images, new characters and NPCs use them instead of the shipped Jon Aspeheim art, and the portrait picker gains a 'Custom' tab. Leave empty or unfilled to use only the shipped portraits. The default folder is created for you — just drop images in and click Refresh in the picker.
CustomPortraitFolder.label: Custom character portrait folder

EnableInventoryReorder.hint: When on, a player may drag an inventory row to reposition it; the manual order is kept.
EnableInventoryReorder.label: Let players drag inventory to reorder them

MaxEquipSlots.hint: Maximum equipment slots for player characters, used for encumbrance tracking.
MaxEquipSlots.label: Maximum inventory slots per character

MinAge.hint: A floor on every generated character's age, applied to all character sheets. Generation and the sheet's age re-roll never produce an age below this. Default 21; set it below 12 (the lowest a 2d20 + 10 roll can give) to switch the floor off.
MinAge.label: Minimum character age (floor for the 2d20 + 10 roll)

ShowGenerateHeader.hint: Show 'Regenerate' button at character sheet header
ShowGenerateHeader.label: Show a Roll Character button on the character sheet header

ShowGenerationRolls.hint: Post HP, STR, DEX, WIL and Gold as one chat message whenever a player or the Warden generates or regenerates a character. Dice So Nice animates them when installed; otherwise the core dice sound plays. Name, background and portrait re-rolls are never posted.
ShowGenerationRolls.label: Show character generation dice rolls in chat

ShowGrantTags.hint: Show a Background / Bond / Question chip on items that character generation granted.
ShowGrantTags.label: Show grant-source tags (Background / Bond / Question) on inventory

UseCairnDiceNotation.hint: Interpret Cairn dice notation like 'd6+d6' as described in the rules.
UseCairnDiceNotation.label: Use Cairn dice notation: 'd6+d6' as keep highest

UseGoldThreshold.hint: Define number of gold pieces which occupies full inventory slot. Zero means that gold pieces are always petty.
UseGoldThreshold.label: Gold that fills one inventory slot (0 = weightless)

UseItemIcons.hint: Show icons for some items in inventory to quickly recognize the type.
UseItemIcons.label: Show Item type icons (weapon, armor, fatigue) beside inventory

UsePanic.hint: Use 2e panic condition for player characters.
UsePanic.label: Use the 2e "Panicked" condition for all player characters

CAIRN.StrTip: Used for saves requiring physical power, like lifting gates, bending bars, resisting poison, etc.
CAIRN.TakeHint: Add it for free (e.g. granted by the Warden), no gold spent.
